Delete Account & Data - Joinly

How to request account deletion: The app does not currently have an in-app "delete account" button. To delete your account and all associated data, please request it by email.

Steps

1 Send an email to marcel.sotak123@gmail.com
2 In the subject or body of the email, include the email address you are registered with in the app, and the text: "Joinly account deletion request"
Send account deletion request

What Gets Deleted (within 30 days of the request)

  • Profile data (name, bio, profile photo, preferred categories)
  • Your account and login credentials (Firebase Authentication)
  • Your personal data from the database (Firestore)
  • Your photos uploaded in the app (Cloudinary)

What May Remain After Account Deletion

  • Events you created (so other participants don't lose their history) — but without any link to your personal profile
  • Messages you sent in other events' chats (kept as part of that event's history, anonymized)
  • Aggregated/anonymized statistics that do not allow identification of a person
Processing time: up to 30 days from receipt of the request.

Contact

If you have any questions about deleting your account or data, please contact us:

Email: marcel.sotak123@gmail.com
